name: @lossless-group/lfm
description: Lossless Flavored Markdown — a polyglot extended markdown pipeline for remark/rehype

scripts.lfm:gh: pnpm build && if npm view "@lossless-group/lfm@$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" version --registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com "--//npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=$(gh auth token)" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "GitHub Packages: version already published, skipping"; else npm publish --registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com "--//npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=$(gh auth token)"; fi

author: Michael Staton <michael@lossless.group>
